statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking changes and is fully backward compatible (existing clients on /mcp and /sse keep working without constraints).
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Mixed evidence, not settled by a concrete check. For end-user clients: at base, ServerContext.organizationSlug was only assigned (mcp-transport, chat, sentry-oauth), never read by tools, so removing it does not change tool behaviour; unconstrained sessions get constraints={} and unmodified schemas. But the exported type ServerContext of the published package @sentry/mcp-server (exports ./types, v0.17.1) changed: organizationSlug removed and a required 'constraints' field added, which breaks TypeScript consumers constructing ServerContext. The OAuth flow also no longer stores organizationSlug in props. Whether 'breaking' refers to clients only or to the package API is not determined; did not run the server or tests.
evidence: gh api pulls/501/files: 34 files; packages/mcp-server/src/types.ts diff removes 'organizationSlug: string | null' and adds required 'constraints: UrlConstraints' to ServerContext

git grep at base cba2147 in packages/mcp-server/src and mcp-cloudflare/src: organizationSlug on the context appears only where it is set (mcp-transport.ts:45, chat.ts:222, sentry-oauth.ts:187), no non-test reads
all tool test files and index.ts/chat.ts callers were edited to the new ServerContext shape in this PR
